d:
Dive into the patriotic fervor with the timeless anthem 'Har Karam Apna Karenge' from the movie Karma, a stirring tribute to the spirit of our nation. Let the melodies of this Republic Day song resonate as we honor the sacrifices made for our freedom.
Song Credits:
Song: Aye Watan Tere Liye
Movie: Karma
Singer: Mohammad Aziz, Kavita Krishnamurthy
Lyrics: Anand Bakshi
Music: Laxmikant Pyarelal
